## Results — fix verified on main (work landed ahead of the pipeline)

**Deliverable:** commit `f59c4598bb422d47c9306740a8bbde5cdbd8dcbe` on `main` ("train: per-call WandB run lifecycle in train_lora — restore per-cell wandb.init (refs #577)", 2026-06-10).

**Root cause (from the commit + #527 upload-verifier evidence):** in-process sweep dispatchers call `train_lora()` once per cell with `report_to="wandb"` + a per-cell `run_name`, but HF's `WandbCallback` only calls `wandb.init` when `wandb.run is None`. Cell 1's run was never finished, so cells 2..N logged into the stale first run with `global_step` rewound to 0; WandB silently drops out-of-order step writes — 17/18 #527 cells lost telemetry.

**Fix (shared call site, so every dispatcher inherits it):** `src/explore_persona_space/train/sft.py` — `train_lora` records `_wandb_run_active()` at entry (line 1053) and in a `finally` block calls `_finish_wandb_run_if_owned(...)` (line 1273), finishing any run the call itself created — including on the exception path (`exit_code=1`) so a crashed cell can't leak its run into the next cell. Caller-owned pre-existing runs (e.g. `orchestrate/runner.py init_wandb`) are never touched.
